name: Priyanka Inventory Insights for WooCommerce
author: priyankachaklasiya

sections.description:
Priyanka Inventory Insights for WooCommerce is a smart inventory management plugin that helps store owners identify low stock products, out-of-stock products, and dead inventory from a single dashboard.

Key Features

  • Interactive Dashboard – At-a-glance inventory summary cards with visual analytics.
  • Advanced Filtering – Filter products by category, product type, and search.
  • Low Stock Table – View and sort products with low stock levels with bulk actions.
  • Out of Stock Table – Track products that are completely out of stock.
  • Dead Stock Analyzer – Identify products with no sales in 30, 60, or 90 days (configurable).
  • Email Notifications – Daily email alerts for low stock and out-of-stock products.
  • Bulk Actions – Export selected products or perform bulk operations.
  • CSV Export – Export inventory data to CSV for offline analysis.
  • Dashboard Widget – Quick stock overview on the WordPress dashboard.
  • Performance Optimized – Supports stores with 10,000+ products with caching and pagination.
  • Translation Ready – Fully internationalized with text domain support.
  • Responsive Design – Works on all screen sizes including mobile.

Why Inventory Insights?

Most inventory plugins focus only on stock quantity. Inventory Insights goes further by analyzing products that are sitting unsold – helping you take action on dead inventory and improve your store’s profitability.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the priyanka-inventory-insights-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Inventory Insights to view your inventory dashboard.
  4. Configure settings under WooCommerce → Inventory Insights Settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin works with all WooCommerce product types including simple, variable, grouped, and external products.

What is considered “dead stock”?

Dead stock is defined as products with no sales within a configurable number of days (default: 90 days). You can adjust this threshold in the settings.

How are notifications sent?

Notifications are sent daily via a WP-Cron job. You’ll receive an email with a list of low stock and out-of-stock products.

Does this work with large stores?

Yes, the plugin is optimized for stores with 10,000+ products using efficient queries, pagination, and transients for caching.

Can I export data?

Yes, you can export inventory data to CSV from the dashboard. You can export all products or selected products using bulk actions.
